aellui.key.hint: Esc or Delete while capturing — unbind
aellui.status.no_schematic: No schematic loaded — settings will apply once you load one
aellui.tip.budgets_add_up: The neighbour mod has its own budget of the same size; they add up
layerlist.config.blocksPerTick.name: Positions per tick
layerlist.config.blocksPerTick.tooltip: Maximum positions scanned per tick. Lower it if huge schematics cause lag
layerlist.config.uiStyle.name: Look
layerlist.config.uiStyle.tooltip: Aell UI — the mod's own look. Vanilla — Minecraft's own buttons, toggles, fields and sliders; settings as tiles in two columns like Minecraft's Options (right-click a tile to reset it). Vanilla+ — the same, but settings as rows like Litematica: name on the left, value tile and Reset on the right.
layerlist.section.ui_style.note: Aell UI is the default look. Vanilla and Vanilla+ switch every window to Minecraft's own look and sounds; they differ only in how this settings screen is laid out.
layerlist.config.materialCutoff.name: Count up to Y
layerlist.config.materialCutoff.tooltip: The material list counts everything at or below the height set below. The layer shown in the world does not change
layerlist.config.materialCutoffY.name: Height Y
layerlist.config.materialCutoffY.tooltip: Highest Y the material list counts. Layers in the world are not affected
layerlist.section.material_cutoff.note: Off: the material list follows the Litematica layer mode. On: the list counts everything at or below Y, while the world still shows only the current layer
layerlist.config.chatMessages.name: Chat messages
layerlist.config.chatMessages.tooltip: The mod reports the panel, the storage search and Easy Place in chat. Off (default) — nothing goes to chat; key presses are still confirmed by a line above the hotbar
layerlist.config.clearSearch.name: Clear marks
layerlist.config.colorsFromBlocks.name: Highlight colors from blocks
layerlist.config.colorsFromBlocks.toolti: When on, every mark takes its color from the block itself. When off, marks are painted with the mod's bright palette
layerlist.config.easyPlaceAutoTool.name: Pick the tool for digging
layerlist.config.easyPlaceAutoTool.toolt: Before a block starts breaking, the fastest suitable tool from your inventory is taken in hand — the way Easy Place already takes the right block for placing. A tool that would not drop the block never beats a bare hand. Survival only, and only while Easy Place mode is on
layerlist.config.easyPlaceAutomationWind: How long after Litematica's Easy Place a click still counts as automated. Only such clicks are corrected
layerlist.config.easyPlaceBlocksPerSecon: Automated placement pace, counted in game ticks — the same clock a server's timer check uses. 20 is a click every tick, 10 every other tick, 5 every fourth; holding right-click in vanilla gives 5. Never more than one automated click per tick, whatever the value. Default 10 — twice as fast as a hand and invisible to most anticheats; if the server complains about speed, use 5. Clicks outside the schematic (chest, door, lever) are never throttled
How long one click waits for the server to confirm the new count before another click is allowed. Raise it on a laggy server
layerlist.config.easyPlaceDebug.name: Easy Place debug
layerlist.config.easyPlaceDebug.tooltip: Every Easy Place decision as a grey chat line: where the click went, what the schematic wants, why the click was cancelled or passed. Turn it on when something does not place — the lines show which check eats the click. Repeats are collapsed
layerlist.config.easyPlaceDigGuard.name: Do not dig the wrong thing
layerlist.config.easyPlaceDigGuard.toolt: While Litematica's Easy Place mode is on, a left click does not break blocks outside the schematic area or blocks already standing exactly as the schematic asks. Only leftover or wrong material inside the area can be dug. A short note above the hotbar says why a hit was refused. What exactly is protected is set in the options below. Off — digging works as usual
layerlist.config.easyPlaceDigGuardOutsid: Do not break blocks outside the schematic area. Off — digging outside is allowed, only correctly placed blocks stay protected
layerlist.config.easyPlaceDigGuardCorrec: Do not break blocks that already match the schematic. A block that differs only in what it adjusts to its neighbours by itself also counts as correct: stair corners, fence and pane connections, leaves
layerlist.config.easyPlaceDigGuardEasyPl: The guard works only while Litematica's Easy Place mode is on. Off — it always protects while a schematic is shown
layerlist.config.easyPlaceDirtForGrass.t: When the schematic asks for a grass block and you have none, the mod places plain dirt and counts the cell as done: grass spreads back from the neighbours on its own if there is light above. A real grass block in the inventory always wins. While the toggle is off, a cell with dirt stays unfinished
layerlist.config.easyPlaceEntities.name: Place entities
layerlist.config.easyPlaceEntities.toolt: Easy Place places armor stands, cushions, item frames, paintings, end crystals and minecarts from the schematic: aim at the entity's ghost. The mod takes the item, clicks the supporting block and turns the head the way the ghost faces; it puts the item into a frame and rotates it. A painting is placed only if the game would pick a motive of the same size; boats are not placed
layerlist.config.easyPlaceFinishTools.to: Vanilla pairs where a block turns into another one under a tool: copper scraped back with an axe or waxed with a honeycomb, dirt tilled into farmland with a hoe or flattened into a path with a shovel, a candle set on a cake, a pumpkin carved with shears (face where the schematic has it). The mod clicks the block already standing in the cell and never places a block into another cell. Where the block has no survival item at all (candle cake, farmland, path) the base block goes down first — but only when the finishing tool is in your inventory. Works in any hologram mode: a standing block you can finish with a tool from your inventory is not hidden, even with «only blocks from inventory»
layerlist.config.easyPlaceFix.name: Fix Easy Place
layerlist.config.easyPlaceFix.tooltip: Master switch. Off — Litematica places exactly as it did before
layerlist.config.easyPlaceFixFilling.too: Glowstone into respawn anchors, eyes of ender into end portal frames, water into cauldrons — bottle by bottle to the level (a full one may take a bucket), lava and powder snow by bucket. Easy Place places the cauldron empty and fills it next. Off by default because it uses up items
layerlist.config.easyPlaceFixLit.name: Light and put out
layerlist.config.easyPlaceFixLit.tooltip: Flint and steel or a fire charge lights candles, candle cakes and campfires; a shovel puts a campfire out; a bare hand snuffs a candle
layerlist.config.easyPlaceFixWaterlogged: A water bucket fills the block, an empty bucket drains it, so waterlogged matches the schematic
layerlist.config.easyPlaceJitter.name: Uneven pace
layerlist.config.easyPlaceJitter.tooltip: Adds a random extra tick to the pause between automated clicks, so the interval is not perfectly regular. A hand never clicks with metronome precision, and some timer anticheats flag exactly even timing. Costs a little speed; turn it on only if the server still complains at a lower blocks-per-second
layerlist.config.easyPlaceNoTurn.name: Never turn the player
layerlist.config.easyPlaceNoTurn.tooltip: The mod stops feeding a made-up view angle to get the right block side and clicks with the angle you already have. No snap turns in the packets — the thing anticheats look at most. The price: blocks whose facing comes from your look have to be placed by hand or skipped
A guard against stray blocks: while Easy Place is working, nothing the cell does not ask for can be placed inside the schematic area — both Litematica's own misses (an extra fence next to the schematic one) and accidental clicks with the wrong block die quietly. May reduce accuracy: a disputed click is cancelled silently, and in rare cases a needed one gets caught — if something stops placing, turn this off A shulker box with items inside is your storage, not a build block — it can always be placed.
Give up on cells the server refuses

If the server refuses a placement in the same cell six times in a row, Easy Place stops clicking it until the cell changes, and says so in chat. Turn this off if you place a block in the same spot over and over — say, rerolling villager trades with a lectern: the mod will always click and stay quiet
layerlist.config.easyPlaceStrictSchemati: An iron guard: no block goes into an empty schematic cell — neither from Easy Place nor placed by hand. Works only within the schematic (the boxes of enabled sub-regions of enabled placements): outside it everything places as usual. The click is dropped before it reaches the server and «off the schematic» shows above the hotbar. Right-clicking chests, doors, levers and the like without sneaking works as usual. Wrong blocks in schematic cells are stopped by the neighbouring «Block placing the wrong block»
layerlist.message.strict_empty: Off the schematic: %s does not go here — the schematic is empty here
layerlist.message.strict_other: Wrong block: the schematic wants %2$s here, not %1$s
layerlist.config.easyPlaceStrictBlock.to: An iron guard: a cell where the schematic wants a block takes only that block — from Easy Place and by hand alike; any other block is dropped before it reaches the server and «wrong block» shows above the hotbar. Works only within the schematic; empty schematic cells and everything outside are left alone (empty cells are covered by «Block placing off the schematic»). Right-clicking chests, doors, levers without sneaking works as usual
layerlist.config.easyPlaceOpenContainers: Chests, barrels, shulkers, furnaces and hoppers open while Easy Place is on. Normally four separate guards eat that click: Schematic only, Litematica's own refusal on an occupied cell, its Placement Restriction, and the aim being moved to an unbuilt cell. The click is let through when you aim straight at the container, are not sneaking, the schematic asks for nothing against that face within the active layer — and the right button was just pressed rather than held from building: held RMB still places blocks and never pops a chest open. Placing a block against a container still works the vanilla way, by sneaking
layerlist.config.easyPlacePoseAhead.name: Aim one tick ahead
layerlist.config.easyPlacePoseAhead.tool: The mod stops sending rotation packets of its own: the angle it needs rides the client’s own movement packet and the click goes out on the next tick. Exactly one movement packet per tick leaves the client, like vanilla, and that is what a server-side timer check counts. The price: a cell that needs turning is placed one tick later, and while the angle is held the server does not see where you really look, so a left-click in that window is resolved from the substituted angle
layerlist.config.easyPlaceReplaceSoil.to: Dirt, grass block, coarse dirt, dirt path, rooted dirt, podzol and mycelium: when the cell holds one of them and the schematic asks for another, the mod digs the wrong one out and the next Easy Place pass puts the right one down. Where a hoe or shovel can convert the block in place, that is done instead (see "Finish blocks with tools"). Off by default because it breaks blocks
layerlist.config.easyPlaceSkipWrongState: Skip what would go in wrong

If no click can give the facing, axis, half or attachment the schematic asks for — usually because the block it must attach to is not built yet — the position is skipped instead of placed wrong. Come back to it once the support is there
layerlist.config.easyPlaceStripLogs.name: Strip logs
layerlist.config.easyPlaceStripLogs.tool: When the schematic wants a stripped log or wood and you only have the plain one, the mod places the plain block and strips it with an axe from your inventory — the same way a candle is placed and then lit. A stripped block in the inventory wins; the axe takes durability
Litematica can encode the wanted state into the hit position (the Easy Place protocol), but only a server that supports it decodes that. If the server is plain and blocks come out facing wrong, turn this on: the mod sends honest geometric clicks and skips the positions it cannot get right
layerlist.config.ghostLeanInnerSides.too: Only draw inner sides where two DIFFERENT blocks meet. Inside a uniform fill the usual culling applies, so a large schematic takes megabytes of video memory instead of gigabytes. Off — every face of every block is meshed, like stock Litematica
layerlist.config.ghostTransparency.name: Ghost transparency
layerlist.config.ghostTransparency.toolt: How see-through the schematic blocks you still have to place are. 0% — solid as usual, 100% — invisible, while the schematic itself keeps working
layerlist.config.highlightBoxes.name: Outline with a box
layerlist.config.highlightBoxes.tooltip: Besides the diamond, outline the container itself with a box
layerlist.config.highlightDotSize.name: Mark size
layerlist.config.highlightDotSize.toolti: Screen size of the diamond above a storage. It does not shrink with distance
layerlist.config.highlightGlow.name: Highlight strength
layerlist.config.highlightGlow.tooltip: How visible the soft fill and glow of a found chest, barrel or shulker box are. Seen through walls too
layerlist.config.highlightOwnColor.name: Own highlight color
layerlist.config.highlightOwnColor.toolt: Every found container in one chosen color. Off — each in the color of its list row
layerlist.config.highlightHue.name: Hue
layerlist.config.highlightHue.tooltip: Highlight color around the hue wheel: 0 red, 120 green, 200 light blue, 280 purple
layerlist.config.highlightInContainer.to: Open a marked chest and the needed slots are filled with their colour; shulkers and bundles holding them get a box
layerlist.config.highlightLabels.name: Labels above the container
layerlist.config.highlightLabels.tooltip: The item name above a highlighted container
layerlist.config.hudBesideContainer.name: Beside an open container
layerlist.config.hudBesideContainer.tool: While a chest, barrel or inventory is open, the panel moves next to the container window: on the side chosen below (right by default), or on the other one when that side is too tight. With no room on either side it stays where it usually is
layerlist.config.hudCustomPosition.name: Custom position
layerlist.config.hudCustomPosition.toolt: Keep the panel where you dragged it instead of the Litematica Info HUD corner. Turns itself on when you drag the panel
layerlist.config.hudPositionScreen.name: Panel position
layerlist.config.hudPositionScreen.toolt: Opens the screen where the panel is dragged into place with the mouse
layerlist.config.hudScale.name: Panel scale
layerlist.config.hudScale.tooltip: Panel size. Change it when the panel is in the way or hard to read
layerlist.config.itemsPerPage.name: Rows per page
layerlist.config.itemsPerPage.tooltip: How many blocks fit on one page of the panel
layerlist.config.onlyMissing.name: Only missing
layerlist.config.onlyMissing.tooltip: Show only the blocks of the layer that are still missing, not the whole list
layerlist.config.useStock.name: Count storage
layerlist.config.useStock.tooltip: Hide what you already have: in your inventory and in chests, barrels and shulker boxes you have opened on this server in this dimension. Only what is missing entirely stays — a list for gathering. A chest must be opened at least once, otherwise the mod does not know what is inside; numbers are as of your last look. While a storage is open the list is full, so "Move everything needed" also takes the hidden items. The same toggle is in the Materials tab of the schematics window. Off by default
layerlist.config.openConfig.name: Settings
layerlist.config.openHudPosition.name: Panel position
layerlist.config.openHudPosition.tooltip: Opens the screen where the panel is dragged into place
layerlist.config.pinAcrossDimensions.too: When you leave the dimension where the placement is, the last list stays on screen as a snapshot: block totals are frozen, but the "in inventory" column and storage search keep working — gather materials in the Overworld for a build in the Nether. The footer says which dimension the snapshot is from.
layerlist.config.countEntities.name: Count entities
layerlist.config.countEntities.tooltip: Armor stands, cushions, item frames (with the item inside), paintings, end crystals, minecarts and boats from the schematic are listed as rows of the item that places them. Totals cover the whole schematic; “missing” is counted where chunks are loaded and checks the cushion color, the item and its rotation in a frame, the painting motive and the armor stand rotation. Mobs are not counted
layerlist.config.openSchematics.name: Open the Schematics menu
layerlist.config.openSchematics.tooltip: Opens the Material HUD Schematics screen: browse schematics, preview them in 3D, place them and export material lists. Works in game while no other screen is open (like Settings and Panel position). Unbound by default — pick a free key
layerlist.config.selectionWorldCursor.to: While the “Look at the world” coordinates card is on screen: bring up the cursor to edit the fields and press “+/−”, press again to go back to playing. Without the card the key works as usual
layerlist.config.refreshIntervalTicks.to: How often the list recounts on its own. Placing a block refreshes it at once. 20 ticks is one second
layerlist.config.replaceLitematicaHud.to: While this panel is on, the native Litematica material list stays hidden
layerlist.config.schematicsExportDir.too: Where spreadsheets, pictures and lists are saved. Empty: the material-hud-exports folder inside the game folder. A relative path starts from the game folder
layerlist.config.schematicsLiveGhosts.to: While a schematic is dragged with the left mouse button, Litematica's ghost blocks follow it (at most 4 times a second). Off: only the outline moves, the ghosts jump there on release. Schematics over 200,000 blocks always move on release
layerlist.config.schematicsMainMenuButto: Material HUD button in Litematica's menu
Adds a «Material HUD» button to Litematica's main menu: it opens the mod's settings, where the «Schematics» tab is too
layerlist.config.litematicaSkin.name: Litematica menu in Material HUD colors
layerlist.config.litematicaSkin.tooltip: Litematica's main menu is drawn in the Material HUD style. Other mods' buttons stay where their mod put them, with a differently colored frame; the Material HUD button smoothly makes room if its spot is taken
layerlist.config.litematicaOwnScreens.to: Litematica's menu buttons open our tabs: Schematic Placements and Loaded Schematics — «Placements», Load Schematics — «Library», Area Editor — «Selection». Hold Shift for Litematica's screens
layerlist.config.schematicsPreviewQualit: How the 3D preview draws a schematic. "Optimized" draws big schematics as cubes: fast and light. "Quality" draws the whole schematic in real blocks while the game has memory for it; on big schematics FPS may drop noticeably and a lot of memory may be used
layerlist.config.schematicsSheetsToken.t: Needed for «Send to team sheet»: the key the script writes to its log during setup (TOKEN). Without it the script refuses to write
layerlist.config.schematicsSheetsWebAppU: Optional. The Google Apps Script web app address that «Send to team sheet» posts the materials to
layerlist.config.schematicsThumbnails.to: Draws a small picture of every schematic in the file list
layerlist.config.schematicsTopHideClouds: While placing a schematic in the top view, clouds are not drawn
layerlist.config.selectionCompound.name: Multi-box selection
layerlist.config.selectionCompound.toolt: “Selection” tab: several components (sub-regions) in one selection — Litematica’s “Normal” mode. Off — a simple one-box selection
layerlist.config.scrollDown.name: Next page
layerlist.config.scrollUp.name: Previous page
layerlist.config.searchFollowsPage.name: Follow the page
layerlist.config.searchFollowsPage.toolt: Turn a page and the search restarts for the new blocks. Marks always match what is on screen
layerlist.config.searchItemFrames.name: Use item frames
layerlist.config.searchItemFrames.toolti: An item in a frame on a container counts as a sign of its contents
layerlist.config.searchRadius.name: Search radius
layerlist.config.searchRadius.tooltip: How far around you storages get marked
layerlist.config.searchStorage.name: Search storages
layerlist.config.searchStorage.tooltip: Marks chests, barrels, copper chests and shulkers holding the blocks you need
layerlist.config.settingsFullscreen.name: Full-screen settings
layerlist.config.settingsFullscreen.tool: This settings screen takes the whole window — room for every tab name and label. Off: a panel on the left, as wide as its tabs need, up to two thirds of the window
layerlist.config.shelfShowEmpty.name: Also outline empty shelves
layerlist.config.shelfShowEmpty.tooltip: Off — only shelves with items are drawn, which is what makes them stand out. On — empty ones get a thin outline so you can see every shelf at once
layerlist.config.shortfallOnlyMissing.to: Count a block as needed only where the world is empty. A spot taken by the wrong block or the wrong state is not counted — that is a job for verification, not for gathering
layerlist.config.showProgressBar.name: Progress bar
layerlist.config.showProgressBar.tooltip: A bar and a percentage of layer completion in the panel header
layerlist.config.showSearchMarkers.name: Stripes in the panel
layerlist.config.showSearchMarkers.toolt: A colour stripe on rows taking part in the search. The colour matches the mark on the chest
layerlist.config.showShortfall.name: Show shortfall
layerlist.config.showShortfall.tooltip: A red "need N" next to the count — exactly how many are missing
layerlist.config.hudCountInBoxes.name: Count in shulker boxes
layerlist.config.hudCountInBoxes.tooltip: Turn on to show the count in shulker boxes from one full box up: "2065 (1.2 SB)". Off — stacks, like the other rows: "2065 (32x64+17)"
layerlist.config.skipItemsInInventory.to: Do not search for what your inventory already covers. Shulkers and bundles count too
layerlist.config.sortByName.name: Sort alphabetically
layerlist.config.sortByName.tooltip: Otherwise the list is sorted by how much is missing — the most needed on top
layerlist.config.sortTranslucent.name: Sort by distance
layerlist.config.sortTranslucent.tooltip: Re-sorts see-through faces as you move so overlapping ghosts blend in the right order. Costs a few frames
layerlist.config.toggleLayerHud.name: Panel on/off
layerlist.config.toggleLayerHud.tooltip: Show or hide the material list
layerlist.config.translucentInnerSides.t: Also draw the faces between neighbouring ghost blocks. Off — a see-through wall reads as one shell instead of a stack of boxes
layerlist.config.verifyBlocks.name: Check blocks
layerlist.config.verifyBlocks.tooltip: Master switch. Off — the keybind does nothing
layerlist.config.verifyBlocksKey.name: Check on/off
layerlist.config.verifyBlocksKey.tooltip: Starts and stops checking the blocks of the counted area — the current layers, or the zone when another mod owns the counting area
layerlist.config.verifyDrawRange.name: Box draw range
layerlist.config.verifyDrawRange.tooltip: Beyond this distance check boxes are not drawn. Lower it if frames drop
layerlist.config.verifyExtraBlocks.name: Extra
layerlist.config.verifyExtraBlocks.toolt: The schematic has air, the world has a block
layerlist.config.verifyFillBoxes.name: Fill blocks
layerlist.config.verifyFillBoxes.tooltip: Also fill the block with the translucent colour of its category
layerlist.config.verifyMaxMarkers.name: Box limit
layerlist.config.verifyMaxMarkers.toolti: Maximum boxes of one category per frame. Guards frame rate on large schematics
layerlist.config.verifyMissing.name: Missing
layerlist.config.verifyMissing.tooltip: The schematic has a block, the world has nothing
layerlist.config.verifySeeThrough.name: See through blocks
layerlist.config.verifySeeThrough.toolti: Check boxes are drawn on top of everything
layerlist.config.verifyShelves.name: Shelves with items
layerlist.config.verifyShelves.tooltip: Marks the shelves around you while the check is on: green and filled for the ones holding items, so you can see at a glance where resources are lying. A shelf’s contents are known to the client without opening it, so this costs nothing
layerlist.config.verifyWrongBlocks.name: Wrong block
layerlist.config.verifyWrongBlocks.toolt: A block of a different type is placed
layerlist.config.verifyWrongStates.name: Wrong state
layerlist.config.verifyWrongStates.toolt: Same block, different rotation, half or on/off state
layerlist.dig_guard.correct: Easy Place: this block already matches the schematic
layerlist.dig_guard.outside: Easy Place: this block is outside the schematic
layerlist.gui.litematica_menu.tip: Material HUD settings and the «Schematics» tab: browser, 3D preview, placing, export
layerlist.gui.move_hud.hint_custom: Drag the panel where you want it. It snaps to the screen edges and center.
layerlist.gui.move_hud.hint_default: Drag the panel to place it yourself — that also turns on the custom position.

layerlist.gui.title: Litematica Material HUD — settings

layerlist.hud.pinned: Snapshot from %s: %s — totals frozen, inventory is live
layerlist.hud.title: Layer materials
layerlist.hud.unverified_chunks: %s chunks beyond render distance, counted as not built
layerlist.message.ep_foreign_restored: Easy Place module is off — EasyPlaceFix re-enabled
layerlist.message.ep_foreign_suppressed: EasyPlaceFix detected and disabled — Easy Place fixes are handled by Material HUD (turn our Easy Place module off to hand control back)
layerlist.message.ep_missing_data_item: Easy Place: cell %2$s %3$s %4$s needs %1$s — an item with exactly those block data (a banner with that pattern, a pot with those sherds), and there is none in your inventory. The material list only asks for the plain item: Litematica caches the required item per block state, and the pattern is not part of the state. Until you craft it, the cell stays empty — placing the plain one would be wrong on purpose
layerlist.message.ep_refused: Easy Place: the server refused this cell too many times (%s %s %s) — skipping it. Usually the cell holds a block other than the one in the schematic: break it and the mod will come back. To keep the mod from giving up on cells, turn off "Give up on cells the server refuses" on the Easy Place tab
layerlist.message.ep_skipped_wrong: Easy Place: skipping cell %s %s %s — no available click would place the block in the orientation the schematic asks for. This is the “Skip wrong state” setting at work: turn it off if you would rather have the block placed anyway
layerlist.message.ep_entity_missing_item: Easy Place: %1$s at %2$s %3$s %4$s needs %5$s, and there is none in your inventory
layerlist.message.ep_entity_reason.boat: Easy Place does not place boats: the game puts a boat where the player looks and turns it the way the player faces, so one click cannot match both the spot and the rotation
layerlist.message.ep_entity_reason.paint: a bigger painting fits here and the game would pick it. Place it by hand or take a painting with this motive from creative mode
layerlist.message.ep_entity_reason.turn: it would face the wrong way, and “Don't turn the player” forbids turning the head
layerlist.message.ep_entity_reason.gave_: the server rejected it three times, trying again in 10 seconds
layerlist.message.ep_entity_reason.cushi: the bottom is out of sight: the server puts a cushion into a cauldron, hopper or composter where your line of sight lands. Stand higher
layerlist.message.storage_search_armed: Storage search: on — every block on this page is already collected, the next page gets marked automatically
layerlist.message.storage_search_empty: Nothing on this page to search for
layerlist.message.storage_search_on: Storage search: marking %s block type(s) from this page
layerlist.message.verify_disabled: Block verification is turned off in the mod settings
layerlist.message.verify_limit: Too many mismatches — showing the first ones found
layerlist.schematics.delete.text: “%s” will be removed from Litematica placements. The schematic file stays where it is.
layerlist.schematics.delete.title: Remove placement?
layerlist.schematics.drop.none: Drop schematic files into the window: .litematic, .schem, .nbt or .schematic
layerlist.schematics.drop.replace.text: “%s” already has: %s. Replace them with the dropped files?
layerlist.schematics.drop.replace.title: Replace files?
layerlist.schematics.error.bad_name: Litematica cannot open a file with this name — rename it
layerlist.schematics.error.load_failed: Litematica could not load the schematic — see the game log
layerlist.schematics.error.load_failed_r: Litematica could not load the schematic: %s
layerlist.schematics.error.needs_litemat: Only Litematica can open this format
layerlist.schematics.error.no_world: Join a world first: Litematica loads schematics only in a world
layerlist.schematics.export.chart.title: Who collected what, blocks
layerlist.schematics.export.dialog.busy: Wait for the export to finish
layerlist.schematics.export.dialog.chart: The «Who collected how much, blocks» chart next to the «Who collected how much» block (Excel, Google Sheets, team sheet)
layerlist.schematics.export.dialog.copie: Table copied to the clipboard, items: %s — paste it into Excel or Google Sheets
layerlist.schematics.export.dialog.disco: Every part has been copied. Press «Discord» again to start from the first one
Copy part %s of %s and paste it into Discord as the next message
Discord: text copied — paste it into the chat
layerlist.schematics.export.dialog.filte: Every block of the enabled placements in the layers the HUD counts — the ones already placed too.

Only the empty spots of the enabled placements (in the layers the HUD counts). Wrongly placed blocks — the wrong block or the wrong state — are not included: break them first. That is the «Only empty spots» setting.
The empty spots of the enabled placements plus the spots with the wrong block or the wrong state (the «Only empty spots» setting is off) — in the layers the HUD counts.
Rows are as shown in the Materials table — search and filter applied.
Every block and entity of the schematic — what the whole build needs.
A schematic is not compared with the world, so here this is the same as «All»: the whole build. Inventory and chests are not subtracted.
Every block and entity of the schematic — what the whole build needs.
Only what is not in place yet: what is already built is subtracted. Inventory and chests are not subtracted.

“Only missing” is what isn't built yet at the build site: a placed schematic and the HUD list are compared with the world. Inventory and chests aren't subtracted, unlike the “Missing” column on the Materials tab. A schematic that isn't placed has nothing to compare with — there missing equals everything
layerlist.schematics.export.dialog.folde: The last export will be selected: %s
Opens in your file manager. Exported files are named after the schematic

Outside the zone the schematic geometry is not built at all. The main source of extra frames
layerlist.zf.config.countByZone.name: Count by zone
layerlist.zf.config.countByZone.tooltip: Materials are counted for the active zone instead of the current layer. Off — Material HUD works as if the add-on were absent
layerlist.zf.config.ignoreLayersInZone.t: Count the whole zone, ignoring Litematica layers. By default the zone is cut by layers too
layerlist.zf.config.scanBlocksPerTick.to: How many positions to process per tick while counting progress of all zones. Lower it if the picture stutters during counting
layerlist.zf.config.searchWholeZone.name: Search whole zone
layerlist.zf.config.searchWholeZone.tool: Chest search takes every block of the zone, not just the visible panel page
layerlist.zf.config.showActiveZone.name: Active zone box
layerlist.zf.config.showActiveZone.toolt: A box around the zone you are building
layerlist.zf.config.showAllZones.name: Other zone boxes
layerlist.zf.config.showAllZones.tooltip: Thin boxes of the other zones. Finished ones turn green after progress is counted
layerlist.zf.config.showZoneLabels.name: Numbers and percent
layerlist.zf.config.showZoneLabels.toolt: Zone labels right in the world
layerlist.zf.config.splitZones.name: Split the schematic into zones...
layerlist.zf.config.splitZones.tooltip: Opens the split screen: a grid by zone count or by zone size
layerlist.zf.config.standaloneSettings.t: Opens the separate mod's own screen: zone verification and its hotkeys live only there
layerlist.zf.config.startMarking.name: Mark a zone with the mouse
layerlist.zf.config.startMarking.tooltip: Closes the menu and turns marking on: hold LMB and drag a box in the world
layerlist.zf.config.subRegionZones.name: One zone per schematic sub-region
layerlist.zf.config.subRegionZones.toolt: Makes one zone out of every sub-region of the schematic
layerlist.zf.config.toolClampToSchematic: The marked zone is clamped to the schematic bounds
layerlist.zf.config.toolEnabled.name: Mouse marking
layerlist.zf.config.toolEnabled.tooltip: Master switch for marking a zone by dragging. Off — the keybind and the button do nothing
A slot-like button beside the inventory panel that turns marking on
layerlist.zf.config.toolKeyHints.name: Controls plate
layerlist.zf.config.toolKeyHints.tooltip: A hint with the controls in the bottom right corner while marking
layerlist.zf.config.toolReach.name: Ray reach
layerlist.zf.config.toolReach.tooltip: How far the marking ray travels. It hits both real blocks and schematic ghosts
layerlist.zf.config.zoneDrawRange.name: Box draw range
layerlist.zf.config.zoneDrawRange.toolti: Beyond this distance zone boxes are not drawn. Lower it when there are many large zones
layerlist.zf.config.zoneFocus.name: Zone Focus module
layerlist.zf.config.zoneFromSelection.na: Take the zone from Litematica's selection
layerlist.zf.config.zoneFromSelection.to: Takes the current Litematica area selection as a single zone
layerlist.zf.config.zoneList.name: Zone list...
layerlist.zf.config.zoneList.tooltip: All zones with progress: click a zone to build it
layerlist.zf.config.zoneSeeThrough.name: See through blocks
layerlist.zf.config.zoneSeeThrough.toolt: Zone boxes are drawn on top of everything — visible from inside the build
layerlist.zf.section.auto_switch.note: When the active zone changes by itself
layerlist.zf.section.module.note_shared: The engine is run by the separate Litematica Zone Focus mod — the settings here and there are one and the same
layerlist.zf.section.performance.note: Technical. Touch it only if the game stutters while zone progress is counted
layerlist.zf.section.schematic.note: What the schematic shows while a zone is selected
layerlist.zf.section.tool.note: Marking a zone with the mouse right in the world; the button beside the inventory and the controls hint
layerlist.zf.section.what_to_count.note: How the active zone affects the material panel and storage search
layerlist.zf.section.zones.note: Split the schematic into zones and build them one by one. The active zone shows in the world; the panel counts it
layerlist.zf.ui.gate.zone_focus_off: the Zone Focus module is off
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.layerlist: Shows a material list HUD for the currently selected render layer instead of Litematica's info panel: it updates as you place blocks, pages through with hotkeys, and marks the chests, barrels, copper chests and shulker boxes that hold the blocks from the current page with bold colored dots — including a highlight of the matching slots once you open the container.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.layerlist: Live material list HUD for the layer you are building, plus colored dots on the storages holding those blocks.
layerlist.section.ghost_inventory.note: Only the schematic blocks you can place right now stay visible. Works inside the layer and the Zone Focus zone; the Ctrl+B check shows only cells whose block you carry.
layerlist.config.ghostInventoryOnly.name: Only blocks from inventory
layerlist.config.ghostInventoryOnly.tool: Show holograms only for the blocks whose item is in your inventory (hotbar, backpack, off hand). Applies inside the visible layer or Zone Focus zone; blocks without an item (water, fire) stay. In this mode the Ctrl+B check shows only cells whose block is in your inventory; extra blocks are not shown In creative the mode stays silent: materials are infinite, the whole schematic is shown
layerlist.config.ghostInventoryKey.name: Holograms by inventory on/off
layerlist.config.ghostInventoryKey.toolt: Switches the «only blocks from inventory» hologram mode. No key by default
layerlist.config.toggleStrictSchematic.n: Block placing off the schematic: on/off
layerlist.config.toggleStrictSchematic.t: Switches the option from the keyboard without opening the screen. No key by default
layerlist.config.toggleDigGuard.name: Do not dig the wrong thing: on/off
layerlist.config.toggleDigGuard.tooltip: Switches the option from the keyboard without opening the screen. No key by default
layerlist.message.ghost_inventory_on_cre: Holograms: only blocks from inventory (in creative everything shows — materials are infinite)
layerlist.message.strict_schematic_on: Block placing off the schematic: on
layerlist.message.strict_schematic_off: Block placing off the schematic: off
layerlist.message.dig_guard_on: Do not dig the wrong thing: on
layerlist.message.dig_guard_off: Do not dig the wrong thing: off
layerlist.config.hudDockRight.name: Right of the window
layerlist.config.hudDockRight.tooltip: Which side of the container window the panel takes. On: to the right; off: to the left. When that side is too tight the panel moves to the other one
layerlist.ui.gate.dig_guard_off: "Do not dig the wrong thing" is off
layerlist.config.schematicsSheetsPalette: Colours of the collection sheet — Excel, Google Sheets and the team spreadsheet sheet. Also asked before each such export. Light grey — grey surfaces with violet and gold accents; dark violet — the dark theme of the PNG card. The team spreadsheet needs the updated script (copy it again) to take the palette
layerlist.schematics.export.dialog.palet: Sheet colours. The choice is remembered — next time just press Enter.
layerlist.config.hudTransferButton.name: «Move everything needed» button
layerlist.config.hudTransferButton.toolt: Above the panel beside an open storage container: one click moves into your inventory every item of the current panel page that this container holds, while the row is still short (missing minus what you already carry). Whole stacks, like Shift+click; the button never sits above the container window
layerlist.config.hudTransferAuto.name: Auto-transfer on open
layerlist.config.hudTransferAuto.tooltip: Same as the «Auto» button next to the transfer button: when you open a chest, barrel, shulker box, dispenser or hopper, what the current panel page needs is taken automatically — exactly the shortage, as with the button. Furnaces, crafting and trading are left alone; no messages when there is nothing to take
layerlist.config.hudTransferInstant.name: Instant transfer
layerlist.config.hudTransferInstant.tool: Everything needed is taken from the container at once, in one tick, not stack by stack. If the server kicks you for fast inventory clicks, turn this off: then it is 4 clicks per tick, like a fast player
layerlist.config.hudTransferAutoClose.to: When auto transfer took everything needed and nothing else on the list is left in the container, the window closes by itself. A container with nothing needed is not closed, so you can still put things in
layerlist.config.hudTransferShulkers.too: The transfer button and "Auto" also take shulker boxes that hold what you need: loose items first, then whole boxes for whatever is still missing (a closed box can't be split, so you may get more than the shortfall). If the loose items would not fit in your inventory, boxes go first — one slot instead of dozens of stacks. Boxes without anything needed stay in the container
layerlist.message.transfer_auto_on: Auto-transfer on: needed items are taken when a storage opens
layerlist.hud.transfer.tip: Take from this container everything still missing for the current page
layerlist.message.transfer_nothing: This container holds nothing that is still needed
layerlist.message.transfer_full: Inventory is full — moved what fit
layerlist.message.transfer_extra: extra could not go back to the container: %s
layerlist.section.ghost_support.note: For blocks that hang on something: hanging signs, glow berries, pale hanging moss, vines. Both options work inside the layer and the Zone Focus zone.
layerlist.config.ghostHideUnsupported.to: Do not draw holograms of blocks that cannot be placed yet because nothing holds them in the world: a hanging sign without a ceiling or a wall, glow berries and pale hanging moss with nothing above, a vine in the air, a torch without a floor. A chain of the same kind counts as held when its first link is. The hologram appears as soon as the support is built
If a block of the visible layer cannot be placed because its support lies in the next layer (a hanging sign on layer N, the ceiling block on layer N+1), that support block is shown too and Easy Place can place it, although it is outside the layer. Only for layer modes; off by default
layerlist.config.ghostFlatNoFill.name: Redstone, rails and string without fill
layerlist.config.ghostFlatNoFill.tooltip: Redstone dust, rails and string get only the cell frame of the schematic overlay ("missing", "wrong block"), without the solid fill: otherwise a blue square covers the pattern itself and you cannot see where the line goes. Off — like Litematica
layerlist.message.transfer_none_needed: Nothing on this panel page is short — nothing to move
layerlist.message.transfer_rejected: Nothing was moved: the server did not accept the transfer
layerlist.zf.config.zoneManager.name: Zone manager
layerlist.zf.card.title: Manage zones
layerlist.zf.card.no_schematic: No enabled schematic — place a Litematica schematic
layerlist.zf.card.hint_split: Split, zone map, list and 3D — on one screen
layerlist.zf.config.zoneManager.tooltip: Split the schematic into zones, see them numbered on a map, pick a zone with a click and follow progress — all in one window
layerlist.zf.config.undoSplit.name: Undo split
layerlist.zf.config.undoSplit.tooltip: Remove all zones of the schematic — the HUD counts the current layer again
layerlist.schematics.place.layers.tip: Which schematic layers are shown (as in Litematica): all, single, all below, all above, range. Click or wheel for next mode, left chevron or Shift to go back
layerlist.schematics.place.layer.tip: Layer number (coordinate along the layer axis). Click to type, wheel and −/+ by 1, Ctrl+C/Ctrl+V to copy and paste
layerlist.schematics.place.name: Schematic:
layerlist.schematics.info.place_zoned.ti: The schematic is split into zones: the placement gets the same zones right away
layerlist.schematics.sync.share.tip: Syncmatica: upload the placement to the server for every player with Syncmatica
layerlist.schematics.sync.server.tip: Syncmatica: shared server placements — load, download, remove
layerlist.schematics.sync.mine.tip: Back to the placements of this world
layerlist.schematics.sync.redownload.tip: Your file differs or is damaged — fetch it from the server again
layerlist.schematics.sync.remove.tip: Syncmatica: delete the shared placement for all players
layerlist.schematics.sync.remove.title: Remove from server
layerlist.schematics.sync.remove.text: “%s” will disappear for every player on the server.
layerlist.schematics.sync.hide.tip: Remove the shared placement only for you — it stays on the server (bring it back via “Server”)
layerlist.schematics.sync.tag.tip: Shared Syncmatica placement: everyone sees changes. Moving needs server permission
layerlist.schematics.sync.empty: No shared placements on the server
layerlist.schematics.sync.place_share.ti: Like “Place here”, and after “Done” the placement goes to the Syncmatica server
layerlist.schematics.sync.edit.waiting: Asking the server for permission to move…
layerlist.schematics.sync.edit.denied: The server did not allow moving — maybe another player is editing it
layerlist.schematics.sync.edit.sent: New position sent to the server
layerlist.schematics.sync.error.inactive: No Syncmatica connection: the server does not have it or has not answered yet
layerlist.schematics.sync.error.already: This placement is already on the server
layerlist.schematics.sync.error.no_file: The placement has no schematic file
layerlist.schematics.sync.error.subregio: The server does not accept schematics with moved sub-regions — reset them
layerlist.schematics.sync.error.failed: Syncmatica did not respond — see the log
layerlist.schematics.save.title: Save schematic
layerlist.schematics.save.from_schematic: Take blocks from schematic holograms (Litematica's schematic world) instead of the real world
layerlist.schematics.save.visible_only.t: Save only blocks visible from outside: fully enclosed ones are skipped
layerlist.schematics.save.support_blocks: Add the blocks the saved ones rest on (supports for sand, torches and so on)
layerlist.schematics.save.exists.title: File already exists
layerlist.schematics.save.exists.text: “%s” already exists in this folder. Replace it?
layerlist.config.searchAllChests.name: Highlight all chests regardless of layer/page
layerlist.config.searchAllChests.tooltip: Marks every chest, barrel and shulker holding anything from the whole schematic's materials — not just the current layer and HUD page. Like the page search, each item gets its own color: the chest is labeled with the needed items inside it, and the HUD row bar has the same color; a gold frame tells this mode apart. Turning it off goes back to searching the HUD page. There can be a lot of marks and the search is heavier than usual. Off by default; turning it on shows a warning
layerlist.config.toggleSearchAllChests.t: Switches the chest highlight between all chests (whole schematic, marked with a gold frame) and the HUD list only. No warning here — it's shown only by the option in settings. Unbound by default
layerlist.message.search_all.warn.title: Highlight all chests?
layerlist.message.search_all.warn.text: Every chest, barrel and shulker holding any of the schematic's materials will be marked, regardless of layer and HUD page. With a big schematic and a big storage there can be a lot of marks and the game may stutter. The page search does not work while this is on.
layerlist.message.search_all.label: Has schematic materials
layerlist.schematics.place.layers.axis.t: Layer axis: Y — horizontal layers bottom to top, X and Z — vertical slices. Click for the next axis
layerlist.schematics.place.layer.to.tip: Upper bound of the layer range. Click to type, −/+ by 1
layerlist.schematics.place.layer.here.ti: Move the layer to where you stand (along the layer axis)
layerlist.schematics.place.msg.paste_xyz: Pasting a position needs three numbers “X Y Z”; for one number click a field and press Ctrl+V
layerlist.schematics.selection.boxes.tip: Components are separate boxes of one selection (Litematica's normal/multi-region selection). “Add” makes a new box, “Name…” renames the one selected in the list, “Remove” deletes it. A simple selection has a single box, so these buttons are not needed there
layerlist.schematics.selection.origin.ex: The schematic's reference point (origin in Litematica). When saving, blocks are stored relative to it; when placing, the schematic is positioned so this point lands where you place it. Toggle off: computed automatically as the selection corner with the smallest X, Y and Z. On: you set it yourself — with numbers, “to player” or the tool in the world
layerlist.schematics.materials.use_stock: Hide what is already in your inventory and known chests: only what is missing entirely stays. Only chests you have opened at least once count. Shared with the HUD setting
layerlist.schematics.materials.cutoff.ti: Count only what is at or below the height set in HUD settings (Count up to Y). Off by default
